CV-200 | WATER + ALK ELECTROLYSIS / H₂ CONDITIONING
H₂ ≥99.9% and CO₂ ≥99.5% are screening targets only.
Draft synthesis anchors only: 7 MPa(a), 250 °C; not frozen design conditions.
CO₂ ≥99.5 mol% dry / H₂ ≥99.9 mol% dry are screening targets, not vendor guarantees.
U-007 fuel gas and U-008 combustion air are not selected; no fired equipment / flare assumed.
